title: バイパス式の剪定ばさみ
description: 公園管理や園芸作業台に置く小型剪定ばさみ。重なり合う曲刃と受刃、刃先の面取り、主軸、左右の握り、実形状の戻しばねと固定ロック片を造形。机上に平置きする開いた一姿勢の静的プロップです。刃の動作・切断・ばね変形は含まず、実用品の切削性能や安全設計を検証したものではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.119 × 0.030 × 0.219 m、3,320三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Small pruning shears for park-maintenance and gardening workbench scenes, with overlapping curved cutting and hooked counterblades, an exposed edge bevel, main pivot, paired grips, modeled return spring and fixed latch tab. A static open pose lies flat for tabletop placement. Blade motion, cutting and spring deformation are absent; this is not a tool design validated for cutting performance or safety. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.119 × 0.030 × 0.219 m; 3,320 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
